params.title: Document
params.note: humaniq-docudesk-documents (2026-07-13): GeneratedDocument is humaniq's log of ONE docudesk render+store handoff (design.md D1), the PayrollGLPostDetail split applied to a document instead of a ledger entry -- gd-status leads with the outcome facts (status/generatedAt/errorMessage), gd-related resolves the Employee and (nullable) EmploymentContract, gd-data carries the remaining fields (documentType/templateRef/filePath) below. No lifecycleActions -- HrDocumentService drives every transition server-side, exactly the PayrollGLPostDetail precedent. Unlike every other humaniq detail page this one IS a document, so the sidebar keeps the library's default Files tab (the stored PDF -- design.md D4, 'the whole point') alongside the default Audit Trail tab, hiding only Notes/Tags/Tasks which carry no meaning here: the custom audit-only `tabs` override the rest of humaniq uses would suppress Files too (CnObjectSidebar's open-enum `tabs` widget registry has no `files` entry), so this page opts into `hiddenTabs` instead of `tabs` -- a deliberate, documented deviation from the fleet's usual sidebar convention, needed to actually show the per-object file. payslip-pdf-docudesk (2026-07-14): gd-data additionally excludes the new payslipId/jaaropgaafId $ref fields -- gd-related resolves both.

params.title: Annual statement
params.note: payslip-pdf-docudesk (2026-07-14): the EmploymentContractDetail two-panel shape -- a leaf aggregate record with exactly one meaningful outbound ref (Employee), so jg-data (totals/payPeriodCount/verrekendeArbeidskorting/loonheffingennummer/aggregatedAt, excluding employeeId) sits at 8-wide and jg-related resolves+links the Employee at 4-wide. No lifecycleActions: Jaaropgaaf carries no x-openregister-lifecycle -- it is a pure data aggregate upserted server-side by HrDocumentService (design.md D2/D4), not a workflow. No files widget: the rendered PDF lives on the GeneratedDocument record that references this aggregate via jaaropgaafId (Related on GeneratedDocumentDetail resolves it), not here -- adding a files widget here would fabricate a second copy of the same document relationship. No child lists: nothing else in the schema references Jaaropgaaf by FK besides GeneratedDocument, which is reachable from the Documenten index instead. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
